_note: Things you can find. `when` lists where they can be spotted just by walking; items with no `when` can only be found through events, secrets or people.

birds.name: Robin
birds.note: Always the first to say good morning.

birds.name: Skylark
birds.note: A song climbing a staircase of air.

birds.name: Nightjar
birds.note: You hear it long before you see it.

birds.name: Mountain Finch
birds.note: Wears the colors of the rocks.

birds.name: Snowy Owl
birds.note: Silent as the field it hunts in.

birds.name: Grey Heron
birds.note: Stands so still the tide goes around it.

flowers.name: Wild Rose
flowers.note: Pretty, and perfectly aware of its thorns.

flowers.name: Sea Thrift
flowers.note: Grows exactly where nothing else will.

flowers.name: Edelweiss
flowers.note: Fuzzy, pale, and very proud of the altitude.

flowers.name: Desert Marigold
flowers.note: A little sun, kept for later.

flowers.name: Frost Aster
flowers.note: Blooms when everyone else has given up.

flowers.name: Moon Lily
flowers.note: Only opens for people who are awake.

songs.name: Rain on Leaves
songs.note: A thousand tiny drums, all in agreement.

songs.name: Wind in the Pines
songs.note: The forest humming under its breath.

songs.name: Slow Waves
songs.note: The sea keeps one long note and never loses it.

songs.name: Evening Crickets
songs.note: Tiny, patient, and surprisingly in tune.

songs.name: Whisper of Sand
songs.note: The dunes, telling each other a secret.

songs.name: The Chime Song
songs.note: Out of tune, which is why you remember it.

songs.name: The Old Traveler's Hum
songs.note: A tune with no beginning, only a middle.

songs.name: The Keeper's Lullaby
songs.note: Sung to the lamp, and to anyone listening.

songs.name: The Aurora's Hum
songs.note: Too high to be real. Too steady to be imagined.
